[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Zom Dubrotin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] who was head of the powerful [[Bomminde family]] and later served as chief administrator of [[Dozu Lam]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="University" />
